q: The condition number κ(A) = ||A||·||A⁻¹|| (in any consistent matrix norm) measures numerical sensitivity. For a linear system Ax = b, a perturbation δb in b causes a relative error in x bounded by:
exp: Condition number bound: ||δx||/||x|| ≤ κ(A)||δb||/||b||. A large κ(A) means the system is ill-conditioned: small relative errors in b can cause large relative errors in x. For Gaussian elimination, rounding errors of magnitude ε_machine produce x errors of order κ(A)·ε_machine.
